import requests, time, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def region(acc,s,e,strand):
    for _ in range(4):
        try:
            r=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",params={"db":"nuccore","id":acc,"rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text",
                "seq_start":s,"seq_stop":e,"strand":strand},timeout=40)
            if r.status_code==200 and r.text.startswith(">"): return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(1.2)
    return None
def promoter(acc,lo,hi,strand,n=1500):
    return region(acc,max(1,lo-n),lo-1,1) if strand=="+" else region(acc,hi+1,hi+n,2)

GENES=[("erg13A","NC_007201.1",1767155,1770030,"-","TARGET"),
 ("erg13B","NC_007196.1",2760413,2762704,"+","TARGET"),
 ("hmg2","NC_007194.1",2961519,2964927,"+","ergosterol"),
 ("hmg1","NC_007195.1",984933,988899,"+","ergosterol"),
 ("cyp51A","NC_007197.1",1777374,1781821,"-","ergosterol"),
 ("cyp51B","NC_007200.1",804300,806312,"-","ergosterol"),
 ("sidA","NC_007195.1",1957978,1966964,"-","siderophore"),
 ("sidI","NC_007194.1",4685088,4687208,"-","siderophore"),
 ("act1","NC_007199.1",1113099,1114850,"-","housekeeping"),
 ("tubA","NC_007194.1",2848154,2850136,"-","housekeeping")]
P={g[0]:promoter(g[1],g[2],g[3],g[4]) for g in GENES}

IUPAC={"A":"A","C":"C","G":"G","T":"T","R":"[AG]","Y":"[CT]","N":"[ACGT]","H":"[ACT]","W":"[AT]","S":"[GC]","D":"[AGT]","V":"[ACG]","B":"[CGT]","K":"[GT]","M":"[AC]"}
def rx(m): return re.compile("".join(IUPAC[c] for c in m))
COMP={"A":"T","C":"G","G":"C","T":"A","N":"N","R":"Y","Y":"R","H":"D","D":"H","W":"W","S":"S","K":"M","M":"K","V":"B","B":"V"}
def rc(m): return "".join(COMP[c] for c in reversed(m))
def count_both(seq,m):
    f=len(rx(m).findall(seq)); r=len(rx(rc(m)).findall(seq))
    return f+r if rc(m)!=m else f

MOTIFS={"CCAAT box (CBC/HapB-C-E)":"CCAAT",
        "GATA element (SreA, iron)":"HGATAR",
        "SRE sterol element (SREBP TCACNCCAC)":"TCACNCCAC",
        "CGG palindrome (AtrR/SrbA-adjacent, CGGN8CCG)":"CGGNNNNNNNNCCG"}

rows=[]
for name,acc,lo,hi,st,branch in GENES:
    s=P[name]
    gc=100*(s.count("G")+s.count("C"))/len(s)
    d={"gene":name,"branch":branch,"GC%":round(gc,1)}
    for lab,m in MOTIFS.items():
        obs=count_both(s,m)
        arr=np.array(list(s))
        null=np.empty(1000,dtype=int)
        for i in range(1000):
            rng.shuffle(arr); null[i]=count_both("".join(arr),m)
        p=(np.sum(null>=obs)+1)/(len(null)+1)
        d[lab]=obs; d[lab+" p"]=round(float(p),3); d[lab+" exp"]=round(float(null.mean()),2)
    rows.append(d)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",330); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",40)
cnt=df[["gene","branch","GC%"]+list(MOTIFS)]
print("MOTIF COUNTS IN 1500 bp PROMOTERS (both strands), A. fumigatus Af293")
print(cnt.to_string(index=False))
print("\nEMPIRICAL p (1000 mononucleotide shuffles, one-sided enrichment) and shuffle expectation")
pv=df[["gene"]+[c for c in df.columns if c.endswith(" p") or c.endswith(" exp")]]
print(pv.to_string(index=False))

print("\nHEAD-TO-HEAD, erg13A vs erg13B:")
a=df[df.gene=="erg13A"].iloc[0]; b=df[df.gene=="erg13B"].iloc[0]
for lab in MOTIFS:
    print(f"  {lab:48s} erg13A={a[lab]:>3}  erg13B={b[lab]:>3}  diff={a[lab]-b[lab]:+d}")

# Which branch profile does each target resemble? Euclidean distance on z-scored motif densities
feat=list(MOTIFS)
X=df[feat].astype(float).values
Z=(X-X.mean(0))/X.std(0)
zd=pd.DataFrame(Z,index=df.gene,columns=feat)
erg=zd.loc[["hmg2","hmg1","cyp51A","cyp51B"]].mean()
sid=zd.loc[["sidA","sidI"]].mean()
hk=zd.loc[["act1","tubA"]].mean()
print("\nDistance of each target promoter profile to branch centroids (z-scored motif densities):")
for t in ["erg13A","erg13B"]:
    v=zd.loc[t]
    print(f"  {t}: to ergosterol centroid {np.linalg.norm(v-erg):.2f} | to siderophore centroid {np.linalg.norm(v-sid):.2f} | to housekeeping centroid {np.linalg.norm(v-hk):.2f}")

df.to_csv("erg13_promoter_motif_scan.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(18,6))
ax=axes[0]
w=0.8/len(feat); x=np.arange(len(df))
colors=["#4f81bd","#c0504d","#9bbb59","#8064a2"]
for i,f in enumerate(feat):
    ax.bar(x+i*w-0.4+w/2,df[f],w,label=f.split(" (")[0],color=colors[i])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(df.gene,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("motif occurrences per 1500 bp promoter"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
ax.set_title("Promoter motif counts, both strands",fontsize=10)
for i,(g,br) in enumerate(zip(df.gene,df.branch)):
    if br=="TARGET": ax.axvspan(i-0.5,i+0.5,color="gold",alpha=0.18,zorder=0)

ax=axes[1]
im=ax.imshow(Z,cmap="RdBu_r",vmin=-2,vmax=2,aspect="auto")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))); ax.set_yticklabels(df.gene,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(feat))); ax.set_xticklabels([f.split(" (")[0] for f in feat],rotation=30,ha="right",fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(df)):
    for j in range(len(feat)): ax.text(j,i,f"{X[i,j]:.0f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,fraction=0.046,label="z-score of count")
ax.set_title("No motif class separates erg13A from erg13B",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[2]

ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["erg13A\nchr8, 1.83 Mb","erg13B\nchr3, 4.08 Mb"],fontsize=10)

for yv,v in zip([0,1],[63094,1316463]): ax.text(v*1.1,yv,f"{v:,} bp",va="center",fontsize=10)
ax.axvline(100000,ls="--",c="grey"); ax.text(105000,0.55,"100 kb",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_title("erg13A is sub-telomeric, erg13B is chromosome-internal",fontsize=10)
